MemeDef.label: abundant table
MemeDef.description: Food is a shared responsibility and a source of joy. These people prize well-stocked kitchens, generous hospitality, and the freedom to choose how much to eat.

animistFact(tag=meme_RR_FoodSupremacy) ->The spirits gather where food is prepared and shared.
